title: Transport of a tensor comparison component square
statement: For arbitrary categories, inclusions I,J and pullback functors F,G, suppose six functor equalities identify the pullbacks and the four curried tensors with fixed uncurried models. If the two tensorators, the pullback coefficient comparison, and the rational and common pullback/tensor components have the prescribed heterogeneous equalities to those models, then the component square for the models implies the component square for the supplied operations. The curried tensorators are required to have the corresponding uncurried components.

source.place: Compatibility; finite-stage representative and supplied-operation normalization.

proof.text: Substitute the functor equalities, identify the comparison isomorphism by its hom components, and use the uncurrying identities to identify both tensorator components. Substitute the comparison components and combine the two factor maps by the tensor functor composition law.

proof_origin.place: Compatibility; explicit finite-model and scalar-unit cancellation.

theorem commonProjectionTensorComponent_of_normalization
    {A B A' B' : Type*} [Category* A] [Category* B] [Category* A'] [Category* B']
    (I : A ⥤ A') (J : B ⥤ B')
    {F F₀ : A ⥤ B} {G G₀ : A' ⥤ B'}
    {TA : A ⥤ A ⥤ A} {TB : B ⥤ B ⥤ B}
    {TA' : A' ⥤ A' ⥤ A'} {TB' : B' ⥤ B' ⥤ B'}
    (RA : A × A ⥤ A) (RB : B × B ⥤ B)
    (RA' : A' × A' ⥤ A') (RB' : B' × B' ⥤ B')
    (eF : F = F₀) (eG : G = G₀)
    (eTA : TA = Functor.currying.inverse.obj RA)
    (eTB : TB = Functor.currying.inverse.obj RB)
    (eTA' : TA' = Functor.currying.inverse.obj RA')
    (eTB' : TB' = Functor.currying.inverse.obj RB')
    (φ : (Functor.postcompose₂.obj F).obj TA ⟶
      (((Functor.whiskeringLeft₂ _).obj F).obj F).obj TB)
    (ψ : (Functor.postcompose₂.obj G).obj TA' ⟶
      (((Functor.whiskeringLeft₂ _).obj G).obj G).obj TB')
    (μ : ∀ K L, F₀.obj (RA.obj (K, L)) ⟶ RB.obj (F₀.obj K, F₀.obj L))
    (ν : ∀ K L, G₀.obj (RA'.obj (K, L)) ⟶ RB'.obj (G₀.obj K, G₀.obj L))
    (a : F ⋙ J ≅ I ⋙ G) (a₀ : F₀ ⋙ J ≅ I ⋙ G₀)
    (tA : Functor.uncurry.obj TA ⋙ I ≅ I.prod I ⋙ Functor.uncurry.obj TA')
    (tB : Functor.uncurry.obj TB ⋙ J ≅ J.prod J ⋙ Functor.uncurry.obj TB')
    (tA₀ : RA ⋙ I ≅ I.prod I ⋙ RA') (tB₀ : RB ⋙ J ≅ J.prod J ⋙ RB')
    (mA : (Functor.postcompose₂.obj I).obj TA ≅
      (((Functor.whiskeringLeft₂ _).obj I).obj I).obj TA')
    (mB : (Functor.postcompose₂.obj J).obj TB ≅
      (((Functor.whiskeringLeft₂ _).obj J).obj J).obj TB')
    (hmA : ∀ K L, (mA.hom.app K).app L = tA.hom.app (K, L))
    (hmB : ∀ K L, (mB.hom.app K).app L = tB.hom.app (K, L))
    (ha : ∀ K, HEq (a.hom.app K) (a₀.hom.app K))
    (htA : HEq tA tA₀) (htB : HEq tB tB₀)
    (hφ : ∀ K L, HEq ((φ.app K).app L) (μ K L))
    (hψ : ∀ K L, HEq ((ψ.app K).app L) (ν K L))
    (M N : A)
    (h : J.map (μ M N) ≫ tB₀.hom.app (F₀.obj M, F₀.obj N) =
      a₀.hom.app (RA.obj (M, N)) ≫ G₀.map (tA₀.hom.app (M, N)) ≫
        ν (I.obj M) (I.obj N) ≫
        RB'.map (Prod.mkHom (a₀.inv.app M) (a₀.inv.app N))) :
    J.map ((φ.app M).app N) ≫
        (mB.hom.app (F.obj M)).app
          (F.obj N) =
      a.hom.app ((TA.obj M).obj N) ≫
        G.map ((mA.hom.app M).app N) ≫
        ((ψ.app (I.obj M)).app (I.obj N)) ≫
        (TB'.map (a.inv.app M)).app (G.obj (I.obj N)) ≫
        (TB'.obj (J.obj (F.obj M))).map (a.inv.app N)
